|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 5, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[Han Solo, Optimistic General (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4).
* '''Original''' ([[Han Solo, Optimistic General]], 22 June 2021): Original: the image at the set's official release (23 June 2021). Players Committee card image, 22 June 2021: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-hansolooptimisticgeneral-original.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/han_solo_optimistic_general.png Holotable commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images”], no mark). Text: “May be targeted instead of a Resistance character by I Want That Map. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Endor] scouts are destiny +1. Cancels Kylo's game text here. During battle with Chewie or [Endor] Leia, may add one destiny to total power.” '''What changed:''' (The release-day image of 23 June 2021 shows the same card.)
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Han Solo, Optimistic General (Errata)]], 27 November 2021): Players Committee card image, 27 November 2021: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-hansolooptimisticgeneral-E1-2021.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/eef4ca7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/hansolooptimisticgeneral.png Holotable commit eef4ca7 “Errata”], mark “E1”). Text: “May be targeted instead of a Resistance character by I Want That Map. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Your [Endor] scouts are destiny +1. Cancels Kylo's game text here. During battle with Chewie or [Endor] Leia, may add one destiny to total power.” '''What changed:''' “[Endor] scouts are destiny +1” became “Your [Endor] scouts are destiny +1”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page, 29 June 2022): Players Committee card image, 29 June 2022: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-hansolooptimisticgeneral-E2-2022.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/64dc6b6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/hansolooptimisticgeneral.png Holotable commit 64dc6b6 “July 1 2022 errata”], mark “E2”). Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Cancels Kylo's game text here. When deployed, may reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand. During battle with Chewie or [Endor] Leia, may add one destiny to total power.” '''What changed:''' the I Want That Map sentence and the scouts sentence are gone; new: “When deployed, may reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand.”
*: [[File:V15-L-hansolooptimisticgeneral-20220629-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Han Solo, Optimistic General (Errata 3)]], 3 July 2022): Players Committee card image, 3 July 2022: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-hansolooptimisticgeneral-20220703-thumbnail.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/4ab16f9/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/hansolooptimisticgeneral.gif Holotable commit 4ab16f9 “Fixing case and making gifs”], no mark). Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Cancels Kylo's game text here. When deployed, may reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand. During battle with Chewie or [Endor] Leia, may add one destiny to total power.” '''What changed:''' the PC's large card image (the one shown at res.starwarsccg.org and in Holotable) was replaced by a 62×87 pixel thumbnail of the card; the text cannot be read at that size (the hires image of 29 June 2022 stayed in the image set). It stayed until 29 December 2024. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Han Solo, Optimistic General (Errata 4)]], 29 December 2024): Players Committee card image, 29 December 2024: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-hansolooptimisticgeneral.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/hansolooptimisticgeneral.png Holotable commit efc26cd “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”], mark “E3”). Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand. Cancels Kylo's game text here. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During battle with Chewie or [Endor] Leia, may add one destiny to total power.” '''What changed:''' the “When deployed …” sentence moves before the Kylo sentence; new: “Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.” The full-size image replaces the 62×87 thumbnail of 3 July 2022. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E3”, but this is errata version 4 by release order (PC-E4); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
